| OB-4 | tldraw, xyflow, primitives | 6 planned | ✘ **short by 3** — table, react, router unswept under OB-4's phrase |

**Verdict.** `ScribbleManager.ts` is the violator, confirmed against verbatim source: `Session` (48–56) records `id, items, state, options, idleTimeoutHandle, fadeElapsed, totalPointsAtFadeStart` — **no page id**; `startSession` (74–99) never reads the current page; `tick` (355–388) ticks and republishes every session regardless of page; and `reset` (341–347) is all-or-nothing, page-blind, and nothing invokes it on a page change. The in-repo counterexample sits in the same folder: `SpatialIndexManager` explicitly tracks the current page in its computed and rebuilds when the active page changes. The cross-repo owners of the same contract, both read verbatim: `queryObserver.setOptions` (138–200) rebinds `#currentQuery` and re-derives fetch state when the key scope changes; `subset-dedupe.reset` (194–202) clears `inflightCalls` and bumps `generation` so pre-reset requests cannot repopulate state.
